2. What you did (the source code and ESLint configuration)

Requesting a new rule? Please see [Proposing a New Rule](http://eslint.org/docs/developer-guide/contributing/new-rules) for instructions.

Yes, this is a conflict with array-bracket-spacing and I would agree this
rule should not be enforced in that situation. I think the colon space rule
will also be problematic in the object case (can someone check that?).

issue.body:
version:   `"eslint": "^1.10.2",`

`error  Missing space before keyword "function"  space-before-keywords`

an array with an anonymous functions chokes the linter:

```
return [function(){}];
```

This works but its a hack to satisfy the linter more than proper coding:

```
  function directive(){}
  return [directive];
```
